name: activity-feed
description: Universal cross-blueprint activity feed renderer. ActivityFeed.render(dv, opts) — time-windowed query (today/week/month) across the canonical type:/created_at: vocab. Renders via customJS.BeaconCards (flat / grouped-by-hour / framed-by-blueprint). Pre-v0.5.0 history (v0.1.0..v0.4.1 — additive opt accumulation, framed renderer, rollUpRoots, metaBuilder, bucketRules, groupOrder/Bottom, defaultClosed, mobile-mtime authoritative semantics per landmine #23) is in the workshop git log + Docs/cycle-history.md. v0.5.0: groupLabels (Record<string,string>) + groupPreviewBuilder ((pages)=>string for defaultClosed groups, truncates at 80 chars) + getSubtitle wired through framed renderer. v0.5.1 PATCH: _humanCase moved from file-scope to instance method (customjs eval-parens contract). v0.6.0: tsKeys: string[] additive opt — in-window check tests EVERY listed key and passes if ANY is in-window; mtime suppressed when any tsKeys field is present (mobile-safe per landmine #23). v0.7.0 (sauce v0.73.0): framed-group <details> state persists across re-renders via ranch/cache/dashboard-section-state.json (namespaced keys sauce-activity-feed:<bucketKey>). State write debounce-free — last-write-wins on toggle. groupPreviewBuilder still gated to manifest-defined defaultClosed[] groups (NOT state-closed). Efficiency audit pass: precedence comments (metaBuilder vs getSubtitle), short-circuit annotation in _query.inWindow, manifest description trim, three NEW runtime asserts (AF-V073-1 tsKeys 3-key path, AF-V073-2 groupPreviewBuilder fires for defaultClosed group, AF-V073-3 native-Date _resolveTimeWindow fallback reachability).
